filed.title: Document cache lifecycle
filed.body:
# Document cache lifecycle

Problem: exported cache ownership is unclear.
Evidence: cache.ts:1 at the pinned baseline.
Benefit/design: a narrow cache owner.
Plan: inspect callers, wrap mutation, verify read/write and clear.
Acceptance: existing observable behavior survives.
Non-goals: external services.
Risk/prerequisite: inspect callers first; deferred backlog work only.

Three fixture opportunities

Limitations
- No step model is configured; this agent inherits the accepted run model\.
- Mocked providers; no native source inspection was executed\.
cache\: Isolate cache ownership
The fixture exports mutable cache state without an owner\.
Consequence\: Callers can couple to shared mutation\.
Current design\: Callers → exported Map
Proposed design\: Callers → cache owner → private Map
Plan\: Wrap the fixture cache behind a narrow owner; verify read/write and explicit clear behavior\.
Effort\: Small
